idea-plugin.name: Metal GPU Monitor
idea-plugin.description:
Metal GPU Monitor — Real-Time GPU Monitoring for macOS

Monitor your Apple GPU performance directly inside your JetBrains IDE. Metal GPU Monitor provides real-time utilization metrics, memory tracking, thermal state reporting, and per-process GPU usage — all without leaving your editor.

Features

  • Status Bar Widget — At-a-glance GPU utilization percentage with color-coded indicator
  • Tool Window — Dedicated bottom panel with live charts for GPU utilization and memory usage over time
  • Per-Process Tracking — See which processes are consuming GPU resources, with IDE process highlighting
  • Thermal Monitoring — Real-time thermal state reporting (Nominal, Fair, Serious, Critical)
  • Configurable Alerts — Get notified when GPU utilization or memory exceeds your thresholds
  • Data Export — Export monitoring data to JSON or CSV for analysis
  • 24-Hour History — Extended historical data retention with charts

Requirements

  • macOS only — Uses native macOS IOKit APIs and Metal framework for GPU data
  • Apple Silicon (M1/M2/M3/M4) or Intel Mac with discrete/integrated GPU
  • IntelliJ Platform 2024.2 or later
